description: Confirm the signed-in shopper's prepared checkout after approval; requires actions:confirm. Revalidates the frozen item, price and destination, then creates an eligible Square payment link/Shopify checkout or records a URL handoff. Returns action_id, booking_id, status, provider and destination_url on success. The shopper pays the provider; a handoff does not confirm purchase.
name: confirm_checkout_handoff
title: Confirm a checkout
